notes.subject: רפאים
notes.rationale: Refaim — ol man dai i kamap ol sait (KJV 'the dead', YLT 'Rephaim'); mi holim nem Hibru

notes.subject: קראיה
notes.rationale: paus pasif — 'ol man [em] i singautim ol i kam', KJV 'her guests'

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: pronon bilong man i no save — Hebri i no gat em

notes.subject: Fomer Meri
notes.rationale: em i tok tok sweet long Stat 9:16–17, tasol tru i Seol — man i no lukim

notes.subject: סתרים / סתר
notes.rationale: bret bilong haid na ples haid — samting i tap wara long ai

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ i no save long samting: ol Refaim i stap long en, ol man ⟨ol i⟩ singautim i stap long ol dip ples bilong Seol.
